# U011-B EXT.IO2 artwork

The one visible rear sticker is a **reference-redraw**, not an extracted vector original and not a photograph crop. It is redrawn from the exact U011-B [official rear photograph](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/extio2/extio2_05.webp), retrieved 2026-10-26. Model-name lettering, pin legend, gray cells, PORT.A.I2C bar, STM32F030 marking and SCL/SDA/5V/GND colors follow that image. The front is blank in the exact-product photographs and remains plain white.

Only `reference-redraw-back.png` is distributed: 3130 × 2342 pixels, reconstructed physical size 16.3 × 12.2 mm, center `[0,7,-4.9]`, rear-facing, projected onto the original shell's recessed existing triangles. Size and placement are image/CAD estimates; no vector drawing or production print tolerance is claimed. A projection does not bridge an actual bore or add physical closure. `artwork:false` removes this panel while preserving shell, PCB, connectors, mounting holes and contacts.

The supplied table, private mappings, private original links, vector source, drawing generator and intermediate reference assets are not part of the public package. This PNG is ordinary redistributable raster output under the user's authorization.
